interpretationLimits: Five already-seen, AI-authored single-turn development cases, independently reviewed by an AI agent; not a blinded holdout or human certification.
The 3/5 semantic result applies only to the selected cases and exact measured source. The other cases were not rerun on this source.
No financial figures were displayed in these five replies, so no numerical-accuracy percentage is established.
Successful provider execution and safe withholding of an invalid query do not establish complete assistance.
The original 35-turn v1 and ten-case v2 results, original automatic assessments, raw artifacts and source-specific reviews remain separately preserved.
No universal accuracy, deployment readiness, hosted-production success or accuracy for later changes follows from this result.
Unknown usage is zero for this run; retained unknown reservations from historical runs are not erased.
Usage-based costs are estimates, not invoices or a verified provider balance.
